mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), sso_issuer = #{ssoIssuer}, sso_subject = #{ssoSubject}, display_name = COALESCE(#{displayName}, display_name), avatar_url = COALESCE(avatar_url, #{avatarUrl}) WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR m.status = #{status}) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, 1 AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.slug, o.name, o.status, o.created_at, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships a WHERE a.organization_id = o.id AND a.role = 'admin' AND a.status = 'active') AS admin_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = o.id AND m.status = 'active') AS member_count, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM organizations o WHERE o.status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
